ratings_why.fun: Every tier does its job and the growth has a shape: Stamps and Landlady passes early, Spawns mid-game, Alder and Mother Redd triples late; the auto-Spawn that pulls a carry out at Start of Combat is the one sour note.
ratings_why.distinct: Leaping up the zigzag and swapping other units downstream is fresh, but a Spawn that comes home to hand with its stats next turn sits close to the Birds' Fly South.

verdict_why: Old Kelt never says whether Stamps clear, so the whole Long Road build is either dead after one lap or loops every Leap.

points.text: Old Kelt keeps the fish on the board but doesn't clear its Stamps, and Spawn fires only on the 6th Stamp, so a kept fish either never Spawns again or Spawns on every Leap. Say it clears its Stamps.

With Little Jack, Old Bradán's Spawn text is 'do every learned text, then forget them all'; it's unclear whether Jack's repeat happens before or after the forget, which decides whether the pair doubles the burst or does nothing.
A 6th Stamp earned at Start of Combat pulls the carry out before it swings. The designer's own fix (a full passport Spawns on its next Leap) would let a climber plan the loss instead of eating it.
Bear at the Long Leap is the best card in the tribe for control: recruit-phase Leaps past him turn Spawn into a choice. Consider saying plainly that his once a turn counts recruit and fight together.
Fish-Pass Trout gives Stamps and no stats; a small fight buff on each back-row Leap would make it a pick on curve, not just in the Spate build.

standouts.why: Spawn on demand at any Stamp count, plus half the fish's stats: it turns the tribe's cost into a decision every turn.
Landlady of the Red Lion Pool catches a whole column under a Kype sweep, a cheap Tier 2 card that teaches the swap trick.
Mother Redd turns Spawns into triples and Discovers, a real Tier 5 direction card.

weakest.why: Fish-Pass Trout adds no stats and only moves Stamps forward; low tempo at Tier 3.
Uncle Faroe's 3 gold arrives only after six Stamps, late for an economy piece.
Tail-Sweep Hen's End of Turn Leap can Spawn a fish just before the fight, leaving the board short with no warning.

flags.note: Stamps are not cleared when Old Kelt keeps a Spawned fish; the Spawn rule fires only on the 6th Stamp.
Order of Little Jack's repeat against Old Bradán's 'then forget them all' is not stated.
Bear plus Mother Redd makes a triple every two turns, every turn with a golden Bear; each triple Discovers.
With Old Kelt and Llyn Llyw a fish Spawns several times a fight, and the Alder gains its full stats each time.
